en.page_title: ERP & Backend Engineering Experience - Bowei Xu
en.page_description: Work experience of Bowei Xu: sole developer of an internal ERP/WMS/MES platform and e-commerce migration at Fuel Cell Store, and trading-platform engineering at DigiFinex.

workExperiences.title: Software Developer - Fuel Cell Store
descriptions: Sole developer for the company's internal operations platform (ERP / WMS / MES), independently architecting a 50+ table relational database schema and 100,000+ line codebase supporting order processing, lot-level material traceability, and fuel cell manufacturing workflows.
Led the live OpenCart 1.5 to 3.0 e-commerce migration for 2,000+ products and 70,000+ historical orders, including custom SQL migration scripts, UI redesign, and zero data loss.
Built and maintained REST APIs, optimized SQL and reporting workflows, stabilized production systems, and used AI-assisted development tools to shorten delivery cycles.
Work directly with business stakeholders to translate manufacturing and operations requirements into software features that match how production actually runs.
Maintain the production systems and servers behind it: Linux, a cPanel/WHM VPS, multi-site PHP and database version management, and OS and database major-version upgrades.

workExperiences.title: Software Engineering Intern - DigiFinex
descriptions: Collaborated with product managers and senior engineers to design, analyze, and implement system features aligned with business requirements.
Contributed to interface protocols, technical documentation, and API integrations for trading-platform workflows.
Developed and tested frontend and backend components to improve system reliability and performance.

zh.page_title: ERP 与后端工程经历 - 徐博伟
zh.page_description: 徐博伟的工作经历：在 Fuel Cell Store 独立开发企业内部 ERP/WMS/MES 平台并主导电商迁移，此前在 DigiFinex 参与交易平台研发。

workExperiences.title: 软件开发工程师 - Fuel Cell Store
descriptions: 作为唯一开发者，独立架构并持续开发企业内部运营平台（ERP / WMS / MES），包含 50+ 张关系型数据库表和 10 万+ 行代码，支撑订单处理、批次级物料追溯和燃料电池制造流程。
主导线上电商平台从 OpenCart 1.5 升级到 3.0，迁移 2,000+ 商品和 70,000+ 历史订单，编写自定义 SQL 迁移脚本，完成界面重设计，并实现零数据丢失。
开发并维护 REST API，优化 SQL 查询和报表流程，诊断并稳定生产系统，同时结合 AI 辅助开发工具缩短功能交付周期。
与业务方直接沟通，将制造与运营需求转化为贴合真实生产流程的软件功能。
负责支撑这些系统的生产服务器运维：Linux、cPanel/WHM VPS、多站点 PHP 与数据库版本管理，以及操作系统和数据库的大版本升级。

workExperiences.title: 软件工程实习生 - DigiFinex
descriptions: 与产品经理和资深工程师协作，根据业务需求设计、分析并实现系统功能。
参与交易平台接口协议、技术文档和 API 集成相关工作。
开发并测试前端和后端组件，提升系统可靠性与性能表现。
